paper_verdict.estimator_family: system GMM (dynamic panel; OLS and FE also shown in Table 7)
paper_verdict.pooling_concerns: Data were normalised before estimation and units are not stated, so coefficients are sign/significance only, not elasticities; dependent variable is GDP per capita level with a lagged DV (long-run effects differ from coefficients); brackets labelled 'Std. dev' and many stars do not match the brackets (e.g. 0.103*** (0.205)); exposures are heterogeneous (internet %, servers per million, per-100 subscriptions); interaction coefficients (FD*ICT, FD*ICT*TO) are not marginal effects; same sample repeated across many specifications; Table 9 prints no n_obs/n_countries; internal instrument validity doubtful in HICs (AR(2) -4.21).

estimates.note: Table 7 LIC GMM (third column); n 513, 27 countries printed. Brackets labelled 'Std. dev', treated as SE.
Table 8 Model5; 540 / 27. Interaction term, not a marginal effect of the technology; poolability doubtful.
Table 10 Model5; 1102 / 58. Interaction term; star is inconsistent with the 0.289 bracket.
Table 9 Model9; coefficient and bracket correct, but Table 9 prints no n_obs/n_countries, so 540/27 is inferred from Table 8. Three-way interaction, poolability doubtful.
Table 11 Model9; 1102 / 58 printed. Three-way interaction, poolability doubtful.
